in_marathi.name: Jaladhija
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of water
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaladhija हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jaladhija is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Jala’ meaning water and ‘Adhija’ meaning ruler or controller. In Hindu mythology, Jaladhija refers to the goddess of water, who is believed to bring prosperity and fertility. She is also known as Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, as water is essential for both agriculture and learning.
